request_seconds.description: Kubernetes HTTPS request deadline in seconds. Owning typed profile policy; restart applies; no request override.

operation_seconds.description: Owning operation deadline in seconds; must be at least request_seconds. Owning typed profile policy; restart applies; no request override.

job_seconds.description: Kubernetes Job active deadline in seconds. Owning typed profile policy; restart applies; no request override.

maximum_body_bytes.description: Maximum complete provider API JSON response/request bytes and public JSON data envelope bytes including the final newline. Oversized public pages fail without truncating retained state. Owning typed profile policy; restart applies; no request override.

maximum_log_bytes.description: Maximum proof log bytes; truncated proofs never succeed. Owning typed profile policy; restart applies; no request override.

maximum_objects.description: Maximum complete bounded resource-list objects; continuation refuses. Owning typed profile policy; restart applies; no request override.

page_size.description: Maximum persisted scoped keyset page items. Owning typed profile policy; restart applies; no request override.

cpu_milli.description: Per probe request/limit CPU millicores, same quota. Owning typed profile policy; restart applies; no request override.

memory_mib.description: Per probe request/limit memory MiB, same quota. Owning typed profile policy; restart applies; no request override.

run_as_user.description: Linux nonroot runAsUser UID; zero always refused. Owning typed profile policy; restart applies; no request override.

id.description: Profile selection identifier Required protected startup configuration; no client override.

name.description: Operator display name Required protected startup configuration; no client override.

server_origin.description: Exact HTTPS Kubernetes origin with explicit address semantics Required protected startup configuration; no client override.

tls_server_name.description: DNS/IP certificate identity, no verification bypass Required protected startup configuration; no client override.

ca_file.description: Absolute canonical0600 CA certificate file reference; trust only, no inline secret Required protected startup configuration; no client override.

token_file.description: Absolute canonical0600 bearer token file reference; never tracked token bytes; rotation requires explicit same-scope rebind Required protected startup configuration; no client override.

namespace.description: Pre-created projectone-test-* isolated namespace; never default/kube-* Required protected startup configuration; no client override.

image_repository.description: Exact approved preloaded OCI repository; digest comes only from verified signed proof Required protected startup configuration; no client override.

image_proof_file.description: Absolute canonical0600 actual manufacturer signed image-subset proof file reference; no invented digest Required protected startup configuration; no client override.

cluster_uid.description: Actual operator-verified current UID/installation/Workspace identity; never a guessed value. Required; restart and explicit same-scope binding.

namespace_uid.description: Actual operator-verified current UID/installation/Workspace identity; never a guessed value. Required; restart and explicit same-scope binding.

control_service_account_uid.description: Actual operator-verified current UID/installation/Workspace identity; never a guessed value. Required; restart and explicit same-scope binding.

installation_id.description: Actual operator-verified current UID/installation/Workspace identity; never a guessed value. Required; restart and explicit same-scope binding.

workspace_id.description: Actual operator-verified current UID/installation/Workspace identity; never a guessed value. Required; restart and explicit same-scope binding.

allowed_cidrs.description: Canonical private/loopback CIDRs; whole prefix must fit approved private space and every DNS result must match. No proxy/public/link-local fallback.

profile.description: Explicit target/native-local distinction; never inferred or silently changed.

mount_root.description: Required canonical absolute actual mount root; no substitute mount.

trust_file.description: Required canonical absolute protected manufacturer trust file; restart required.

allow_test_fixture.description: Fixed production admission. Synthetic fixture permission is refused.

maximum_manifest_bytes.description: Existing offlinefactory verification bound; bytes/count according to field. Omission uses existing typed default; restart required.

maximum_assets.description: Existing offlinefactory verification bound; bytes/count according to field. Omission uses existing typed default; restart required.

maximum_asset_bytes.description: Existing offlinefactory verification bound; bytes/count according to field. Omission uses existing typed default; restart required.

maximum_total_bytes.description: Existing offlinefactory verification bound; bytes/count according to field. Omission uses existing typed default; restart required.

maximum_metadata_bytes.description: Existing offlinefactory verification bound; bytes/count according to field. Omission uses existing typed default; restart required.

maximum_archive_entries.description: Existing offlinefactory verification bound; bytes/count according to field. Omission uses existing typed default; restart required.
